sql.query: SELECT ce.id,CONCAT(ce.legalName,CASE WHEN ce.tradingName IS NULL OR ce.tradingName='' OR ce.tradingName=ce.legalName THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' (',ce.tradingName,')') END) entityLabel,ce.isDefault FROM tbl_contracting_entities ce WHERE ce.tenantId=:tenantId AND ce.isActive=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ce.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY ce.isDefault DESC,ce.legalName
